about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of a private detective sent to investigate a family's mysterious disappearance in 1993, Northern Maine. Uncover evidence, document your findings, and face the creeping horror hidden within the abandoned Wellmont farm.

Demo Features:

  • Approximately 15–35 minutes of gameplay

  • Fully playable section of the first act (includes living room, kitchen, hallway, Ethan’s room, greenhouse and basement)

  • Core gameplay mechanics: clue hunting, document reading, flashlight navigation, and evidence photographing

  • Includes 1 jumpscare and several scripted atmospheric events

  • Voiceovers in English, subtitles & UI in English, German, French, Italian, Slovak, Czech, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Polish, Turkish, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Hungarian, Russian

  • Controller and keyboard/mouse support

This demo is limited to the early portion of the game and does not include access to the upper floors, certain rooms within the house, or any hidden areas. Supernatural elements and full story progression are only available in the complete game.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When the world itself turns against you.
Perception falters as the environment distorts and logic begins to collapse. Details no longer add up, time slips between moments, and you begin to question if any of this is real.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Not everything you hear is in your head.
Darkness deepens, sounds grow sharper, and something unseen begins to close in. The house itself starts to feel alive, reacting to every breath and every step.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Every answer unlocks a darker question.
Interact with notes, locks, and clues to progress and piece together the case. What seems like evidence soon raises suspicion, and even the simplest objects begin to feel intentionally placed.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Uncover what was left behind.
Step carefully through silent rooms, untouched belongings and forgotten memories. Every corner holds a trace of the family’s life and offers a glimpse into what might have ended it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WARNING:

Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: This demo features unsettling environments, psychological tension. Some scenes include blood and may be disturbing to sensitive players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5700 or Intel Core i5-11500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading

short_description: The Wellmonts Case Demo is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1993, Northern Maine. As a private detective, you explore the abandoned Wellmont farm, search for clues, photograph unsettling evidence, and uncover the truth behind a family's unexplained disappearance.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Slovak
*languages with full audio support
